dialogues.speaker: Sieciech
dialogues.text: I've gathered quite a bit of intel this time. I suppose it's good business etiquette to share them with the Curatorium of Secrets...

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: Oh? You'd like to retrace the battles? Please, by all means.

choices.text: If it benefits Nefer, I'm all for it!

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: I'm actually indebted to the Curatorium in a way... Miss Nefer has provided us with intel that has helped my squad on several occasions.
